title: AI Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer in Birmingham, you will help build and maintain AI solutions for a Professional Services organisation, improving how they work and deliver to their clients. The AI Engineer will focus on DevOps, Automated Deployment, AI platforms and application integration to deliver automated solutions that support stakeholders business wide.

Client Details

Our client is a market leading legal firm, based in the heart of Birmingham city centre. They are looking to implement AI and modern application technologies to improve their offering and how they work and so require an AI engineer to support.

Description

Duties of the AI Engineer:

  • Develop and maintain DevOps processes using Azure DevOps, including source control, CI/CD pipelines, release management and environment management.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated deployment processes, primarily using Microsoft Azure technologies such as Bicep.
  • Support the development and deployment of solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and other Microsoft Azure AI services.
  • Work closely with application developers to establish appropriate development, test and production environments and deployment processes.
  • Support the integration of AI and automation solutions with existing applications and services using APIs, Microsoft Power Platform and other appropriate Microsoft technologies.
  • Support the deployment of modern applications and services within the firm's Azure environment, including containerised applications where appropriate.
  • Apply appropriate security, identity and access controls to AI, automation and application deployments, including least-privilege access, secrets management and secure configuration.
  • Help move AI and automation projects from proof of concept into production by establishing repeatable deployment, monitoring, documentation and support processes.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable technical standards and approaches for Azure DevOps, AI platforms, automation and application deployment.
  • Evaluate new Microsoft AI, automation and DevOps capabilities and advise on their suitability for the firm's technology environment.
  • Work with third-party developers, architects and technology partners where specialist skills or additional delivery capacity are required.
  • Produce clear technical and operational documentation covering deployments, configuration, support requirements and ongoing maintenance.

Profile

A successful 'AI Engineer' should have:

  • Experience of working with AI platforms, LLMs or AI-enabled applications, with Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI experience being advantageous, including model deployment, lifecycle and version management across environments
  • At least 3 years' experience in a DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering or similar technical role.
  • Strong understanding of DevOps principles, including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment and release management.
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Azure DevOps, or equivalent experience that can be readily applied to Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably using Azure Bicep or similar Azure-focused tooling.

Job Offer

  • Permanent AI Engineer role based in Birmingham.
  • Salary of £70000 to £75000, dependent on the level of experience.
  • Hybrid role (2 days in the office)

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
